boxes.title: Impact on commerce & MSMEs
items: **Common national market**; ended ==**cascading effect**== via ITC at every stage
**E-way bill**: goods over **Rs 50,000**; valid 1 day per 200 km
Border check-posts dismantled → lower logistics cost
Taxpayers **66.5 lakh (2017) → 1.51 crore (2025)** = formalisation
**Composition scheme**: turnover up to **Rs 1.5 crore** (**Rs 50 lakh** services); **1%** goods / **6%** services; no ITC

cards.title: Inverted Duty Structure
lines: Input rate > output rate → ITC piles up

boxes.title: Impact on States
items: Surrendered **VAT, entry tax, luxury tax, entertainment tax, octroi** → autonomy loss
Only **16 States/UTs** above national average post-settlement growth
Compensation: ==**5 years (July 2017 - June 2022)** at **14%** growth== over 2015-16 base
Cess extended to **March 2026** for COVID loans; scrapped **22 Sep 2025** except tobacco
Unused balance: **50%** Centre, **50%** States

boxes.title: Unresolved issues
items: Council voting: Centre **1/3**, States **2/3**; needs ==**3/4**== → Centre has veto
**Petroleum & electricity** outside GST; date set by Council (**Art. 279A(5)**)
**GSTAT**: Principal Bench **New Delhi**; launched **Sep 2025**, hearings **Dec 2025**
Classification disputes; multiple returns; demand for **GST 3.0**
**Mohit Minerals (2022)**: Council recommendations ==persuasive, not binding==

boxes.title: AP angle
items: GST = ==**38%**== of own tax revenue (**Rs 36,296 crore**, 2024-25 RE); largest source
Dec 2025 net GST **₹2,652 cr**, +5.78% (national 5.61%)
**AI-powered GST model**: Legal-AI on ~**22,000** judgments; studied by TN, Bihar, Kerala

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Biggest drawback of multiple rates: ==**misclassification**== (APPSC-G1 2017)
GST from **1 July 2017**; **101st Amendment Act, 2016**; Arts. **246A, 269A, 279A**
